patches.summary: Correct the live contact name finder route and add local name matching with associated phones.
patches.reason: Lawmatics documents the name as a path parameter; the generated query binding and ID-based local fallback cannot implement this lookup. The route binding should be corrected upstream; the local contact/phone projection belongs here because it uses Lawmatics-specific fields and relationships.

patches.summary: Add a first-class `forms` command group (list/get/fields/entries/submit) for the /v1/forms resource the generator omitted.
patches.reason: Custom Forms are live on the API but absent from the generated interface list, and filling one out needs behavior no endpoint mirror provides: fields=all expansion, row flattening, name resolution, and submit-body assembly.
patches.validated_outcome: Form 450 (797 rows) flattens to its fillable components in form order, deduplicated; `forms submit --json-file` posts a body keyed by component id.

patches.summary: Add read-only `campaigns` and `sources` interfaces, and let a visible command group opt into the `api` index with pp:interface.
patches.reason: Both endpoints are live but missing from the generated tree; the annotation keeps `api` an accurate audit of the endpoint surface now that one interface is also a top-level command.

patches.summary: Split the request path so a caller can POST a pre-encoded body with its own Content-Type.
patches.reason: Form submissions with file attachments must be multipart/form-data, which the JSON-only client could not express; the dry-run preview now also renders non-JSON bodies.

patches.summary: Install the pinned Go toolchain, dependencies, and CLI in fresh orbs.
patches.reason: This repository's orb did not have Go or the CLI installed; persist the verified setup for future development.
